messages:
Rae Kim: Quick design review note — in the compact compare table users miss pinned rows because the pin icon disappears when badges collapse. Seen in today's test session. :thinking:
Owen Park: yep. compact density hides badge column. users scanned left-to-right and never saw the pin.
Lia Gomez: options: left accent stripe, tiny dot at row start, or always-on mini pin glyph. I prefer stripe + hover reveal to keep visual noise low.
Owen Park: stripe is low-friction but check contrast. if 2px fails, fallback to 3px or add a tiny dot. Also we need aria-pressed on pin control and aria-roledescription on the row.
a11y-bot: Accessibility rules: persistent indicators must have accessible name. Add aria-roledescription="pinned row" and aria-pressed="true" on the pin toggle. Ensure stripe contrast >= 3:1; fallback to wider stripe or icon.
Rae Kim: another thing: perf badge tooltip gets clipped by action chevrons in tight rows. replication: Catalog -> View: Compact -> hover perf badge near actions. Tooltip sits behind chevron.
Lia Gomez: action chevrons render in a portal which causes z-index conflicts. Quick fixes: 1) set action portal z-index lower than global tooltip layer, or 2) mount tooltip to global overlay and position by coords.
Owen Park: small pragmatic patch I tested: set .action-portal { z-index: 900; } .global-tooltip { z-index: 1000; } and add .perf-badge { padding: 6px; margin: -6px; } to widen hit area without changing layout.
Rae Kim: for screen readers, don't rely on ephemeral visual tooltips. Add aria-describedby on the badge with full text like "Performance 91 — latency 110ms, est $0.002/tk". Tooltip remains visual-only.
a11y-bot: Tooltip guidance: use role="tooltip" for read-only content and aria-describedby for SR. If tooltip contains interactive controls, use role="dialog" and manage focus. Add 100ms show delay to reduce flicker.
Lia Gomez: chevron hit target is 18px now; bump to 24px via transparent padding. Keep visual density unchanged.
Owen Park: pin discovery UX: implement 2px left stripe (token: --color-accent-pin) with hover reveal of full pin glyph. Add tests for keyboard nav order: checkbox -> pin -> badge -> actions.
Rae Kim: action items: Owen -> branch with portal z-index + chevron padding + aria-describedby; Lia -> Figma updates for stripe/dot variants and copy; Rae -> add accessibility checklist to PR. I'll loop eng-frontend once draft PR is up. :thumbsup:
